selection: Canonical validation selection before benchmark scoring; selected scene rendered with its saved parameters and solved connections. Selected programs without connect calls or Params have no fitting variables and remain explicitly unfitted; no post-selection program edits were made.
comparison_note: These searches use fit-on-evaluate at 1e71675. Archived GPT-6 film searches used 05fe792, with ten connect fits run after selection.
success_rule: Chamfer times 1000 <= 10; no missing or extra joints; paired joint type score 1, axis error <= 10 degrees, pivot error <= 0.1 when defined. Range error is the mean of available paired joint range errors and is not part of this success rule.
